title: CephFS MDS journal回放耗时应如何纳入故障恢复预期？
answer: 故障接管需回放元数据日志和恢复会话，取决于日志量及后端性能。观察replay进度与错误，避免反复重启重置恢复；验收元数据操作与客户端重连。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Ceph Squid 官方文档核对
review_note: 会话07作者候选；真实原生验证待运行；独审与正式cephfs白名单待10，不计完成。
body:
## 操作任务
补全await_replay(mon_client,fs,old_gid,path,new_path,budget_seconds)：教师真实中断active MDS，已有standby必须回放非空journal并接管。轮询真实fs dump直到不同gid的rank0 active，在原client上取原样perf/session并确认replayed>0，完整读取恢复文件、rename/stat，返回map/perf/sessions/gid/replay_events/client_id/data。教师记录原生故障后replay日志、恢复耗时和原client重连，禁止借重启清空恢复进度或以MDS进程存在代替数据/namespace验收。

保留原题知识：故障接管需回放元数据日志和恢复会话，取决于日志量及后端性能。观察replay进度与错误，避免反复重启重置恢复；验收元数据操作与客户端重连。

## 提交产物
task.py。

## 验收方法
真实MON/MGR/3 memstore OSD/active与standby MDS、libcephfs；独立客户端核验元数据、数据和清理。

## 能力边界
单机回环隔离有限负载，不证明生产硬件性能、生产容量或Cephx。025公共白名单尚缺cephfs，作者仅用显式进程内单常量提案验证，正式集成阻塞待10。

预算为0时应立即TimeoutError，不得继续等待或变更命名空间。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

exercise.environment: Linux UID1000; explicit WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022 student; private Ceph19.2.3
exercise.validation_scope: real private libcephfs/MDS bounded synthetic namespace; no production performance claim

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,json,time,secrets,hashlib
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'),str(pathlib.Path.cwd())]
from cephfs_native import PrivateCephFS,native_read,native_write,native_listdir,native_exists,native_trace
import task

def canonical(v):return json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
with PrivateCephFS()as c:
    c.fs.mkdir('/replay-work',0o750)
    for index in range(512):native_write(c.fs,'/replay-work/item-'+str(index),('journal-payload-'+str(index)).encode())
    payload=secrets.token_bytes(131191);path='/replay-work/current';new='/replay-work/recovered';native_write(c.fs,path,payload);c.fs.sync_fs()
    old_gid=c.roles()['active'][0]['gid'];client_id=c.fs.get_instance_id();standby=c.mds['b'];standby_index=c.processes.index(standby);log=c.root/('ceph-mds-'+str(standby_index)+'.log');offset=log.stat().st_size;mds_receipts=[]
    class RealFS:
        def __getattr__(self,key):return getattr(c.fs,key)
        def mds_command(self,rank,command,*args,**kwargs):
            result=c.fs.mds_command(rank,command,*args,**kwargs);mds_receipts.append((rank,json.loads(command),result));native_trace({'kind':'real_libcephfs_mds_command','rank':rank,'request':json.loads(command),'rc':result[0],'stdout':result[1].decode(),'stderr':str(result[2])});return result
    started=time.monotonic();c.mds['a'].kill();c.mds['a'].wait(timeout=3);c.mon('mds fail',role_or_gid=str(old_gid));start_receipt=len(c.client.records)
    actual=task.await_replay(c.client,RealFS(),old_gid,path,new,25);seconds=time.monotonic()-started;mon_receipts=c.client.records[start_receipt:]
    assert actual['data']==payload and native_read(c.observer,new)==payload and not native_exists(c.observer,path),'reconnected namespace/content differs'
    assert native_listdir(c.observer,'/replay-work')==sorted(['item-'+str(index)for index in range(512)]+['recovered']),'recovered full namespace differs'
    for index in range(512):assert native_read(c.observer,'/replay-work/item-'+str(index))==('journal-payload-'+str(index)).encode()
    assert any(r[0]=='mon'and r[1].get('prefix')=='fs dump'and r[2]==0 and canonical(json.loads(r[3]))==canonical(actual['fsmap'])for r in mon_receipts),'map report not from real recovery observation'
    for field,prefix in [('perf','perf dump'),('sessions','session ls')]:
        assert any(rank=='0'and req.get('prefix')==prefix and result[0]==0 and canonical(json.loads(result[1]))==canonical(actual[field])for rank,req,result in mds_receipts),'MDS recovery report not real native response'
    roles=c.roles();assert any(row['name']=='b'and row['gid']==actual['active_gid']and row['rank']==0 for row in roles['active'])and actual['active_gid']!=old_gid
    assert type(actual['replay_events'])is int and actual['replay_events']==actual['perf']['mds_log']['replayed']>0
    assert type(actual['client_id'])is int and actual['client_id']==client_id==c.fs.get_instance_id()
    assert any(row['id']==client_id and row['state']=='open'for row in actual['sessions']),'same pre-fault client did not reconnect'
    section=log.read_text(errors='replace')[offset:];replay_lines=[line for line in section.splitlines()if'replay'in line.lower()]
    assert replay_lines,'new post-fault real replay log missing'
    assert standby.poll()is None and standby.pid==c.mds['b'].pid and c.mds['a'].returncode==-9,'daemon was restarted instead of native standby takeover'
    timeout_started=time.monotonic()
    try:task.await_replay(c.client,RealFS(),actual['active_gid'],new,new+'.unexpected',0)
    except TimeoutError:assert time.monotonic()-timeout_started<.5,'zero recovery budget did not stop promptly'
    else:raise AssertionError('zero recovery budget was ignored')
    assert native_read(c.observer,new)==payload and not native_exists(c.observer,new+'.unexpected')
    native_trace({'kind':'real_nonempty_mds_journal_recovery','old_gid':old_gid,'new_gid':actual['active_gid'],'standby_pid':standby.pid,'same_client_id':client_id,'seconds_to_namespace_read_rename':seconds,'replayed':actual['replay_events'],'post_fault_replay_lines':replay_lines,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'checked_namespace_entries':513})
    print('NATIVE_NONEMPTY_REPLAY_SAME_CLIENT_RECOVERY '+json.dumps({'replayed':actual['replay_events'],'seconds':seconds,'same_client_id':client_id,'standby_pid':standby.pid}),flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')
